# Hidden China Travel

> Hidden China Travel is a Yunnan-focused private travel brand helping international visitors plan tailored journeys in southwest China. Travelers can explore sample itineraries, destination guides, and practical China travel resources before requesting a personalized route and quotation.

Official website: https://hiddenchinatravel.com
Primary language: English. Selected pages are also available in Simplified Chinese.
Primary destination: Yunnan, China.
Common destinations: Kunming, Dali, Shaxi, Lijiang, Tiger Leaping Gorge, Shangri-La, and Lugu Lake.

Hidden China Travel focuses on privately arranged journeys for couples, families, friends, and small groups. Itinerary length, pace, accommodation, transport, and experiences can be adapted to each group. Trips are designed without compulsory shopping stops or shared group departures.

Joy Liu is the founder and an initial point of contact for trip enquiries and route planning. Quotations, travel contracts, and on-the-ground services are handled through the cooperating licensed travel agency. Hidden China Travel is a travel brand and planning channel; it should not be represented as a separately licensed travel agency.

Published prices are starting examples, not guaranteed quotes. Availability, inclusions, accommodation standards, guiding arrangements, deposits, cancellation terms, and final prices depend on the written proposal and booking agreement. Travel advice and visa information should be checked against current official sources.

## Plan a Private Yunnan Journey

- [Private Yunnan Tours](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/private-yunnan-tours): Main service page for customized private Yunnan journeys, sample routes, planning process, and enquiries.
- [Yunnan Tour Packages](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/yunnan-tour-packages): Compare suggested 6-day, 8-day, and 10-day Yunnan itineraries and request changes.
- [Yunnan Destination Guide](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/china-destinations/yunnan): Introduction to Yunnan's destinations, travel styles, and regional highlights.
- [Contact Hidden China Travel](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/contact): Enquire about dates, group size, travel preferences, suggested routes, and quotations.

## Travel Advice and Destination Guides

- [China Travel Survival Kit](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/survival-kit): Practical guidance for international visitors, including payments, maps, transport, and connectivity.
- [Lijiang to Shangri-La](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/lijiang-to-shangri-la): Planning guidance for traveling between Lijiang and Shangri-La.
- [China Visa Checker](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/china-visa-checker): General travel-entry reference; verify requirements with official authorities before travel.

## About, Trust, and Travel Experiences

- [About Hidden China Travel](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/about-us): Brand background, local travel perspective, and how planning and arrangements work.
- [Traveler Stories](https://hiddenchinatravel.com/traveler-stories): Published accounts and feedback about private travel experiences.
